title: The Cech resolution and derived direct image
statement:
Let $S=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, let $f:X\to S$ be a separated,
quasi-compact morphism, and choose a finite affine open cover
$X=\bigcup_{i=1}^t U_i$. For a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module
$\mathcal F$, write $U_J=\bigcap_{j\in J}U_j$ and $j_J:U_J\to X$.
The augmented alternating Cech complex of sheaves

$$
0\longrightarrow\mathcal F\longrightarrow
\prod_i j_{i,*}(\mathcal F|_{U_i})\longrightarrow
\prod_{i<j}j_{ij,*}(\mathcal F|_{U_{ij}})\longrightarrow\cdots
$$

is exact. Its non-augmented terms are $f_*$-acyclic, so applying
$f_*$ to it computes $Rf_*\mathcal F$.

proof.text:
Fix a point of $X$ and a covering open $U_i$ containing it.
Restrict the augmented complex to $U_i$. This restricted cover
contains the entire space $U_i$ as one member; insertion of that
index gives a contracting homotopy of the augmented Cech complex.
Thus the complex is locally exact, and hence exact as a complex
of sheaves. This argument does not identify a boundary stalk of
an open direct image with zero.

The intersections $U_J$ are affine: $S$ is affine and $f$ is separated, so by [lem-weil-pbc-separated-affine-open-intersection], applied repeatedly, every finite intersection of the affine opens $U_i$ is affine. Each $j_J$ is an affine morphism, since for an affine open $W\subseteq X$ its inverse image $U_J\cap W$ is affine by the same node. The composite $f\circ j_J:U_J\to S$ is a morphism of affine schemes, hence affine: the inverse image of an affine open $V\subseteq S$ is $U_J\times_S V$, a fibre product of affine schemes over the affine $S$. Since $\mathcal F|_{U_J}$ is quasi-coherent, [lem-pc-affine-morphism-hi] applied to $j_J$ and to $f\circ j_J$ gives $R^qj_{J,*}(\mathcal F|_{U_J})=0$ and $R^q(f\circ j_J)_*(\mathcal F|_{U_J})=0$ for $q>0$.

Since $j_J$ is an open immersion, $j_J^*$ is restriction to $U_J$, an exact left adjoint of $j_{J,*}$; hence $j_{J,*}$ sends injective $\mathcal O_{U_J}$-modules to injective $\mathcal O_X$-modules, which are $f_*$-acyclic. The categories of $\mathcal O_{U_J}$-, $\mathcal O_X$- and $\mathcal O_S$-modules are Grothendieck abelian by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], and $j_{J,*}$, $f_*$ are left exact additive, so $(j_{J,*},f_*)$ is a composable pair [def-sp-composite-acyclicity] with $j_{J,*}$ sending injectives to $f_*$-acyclics, and $f_*\circ j_{J,*}=(f\circ j_J)_*$. [thm-sp-grothendieck] gives a first-quadrant spectral sequence $E_2^{p,q}=R^pf_*\bigl(R^qj_{J,*}(\mathcal F|_{U_J})\bigr)\Rightarrow R^{p+q}(f\circ j_J)_*(\mathcal F|_{U_J})$. By Step 2, $E_2^{p,q}=0$ for $q>0$, so every differential into or out of the row $q=0$ vanishes, the finite abutment filtration has a single nonzero graded piece, and $R^pf_*\bigl(j_{J,*}(\mathcal F|_{U_J})\bigr)\cong R^p(f\circ j_J)_*(\mathcal F|_{U_J})=0$ for $p>0$ by Step 2. As $R^pf_*$ is additive, each finite product $\prod_{|J|=p+1}j_{J,*}(\mathcal F|_{U_J})$, i.e. each non-augmented Cech term, is $f_*$-acyclic.

By Step 1 the augmented alternating Cech complex is an exact augmented complex $0\to\mathcal F\to C^0\to\cdots\to C^{t-1}\to0$ (alternating terms vanish in degrees $\geq t$), and by Step 3 every $C^p$ is $f_*$-acyclic. The category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules has enough injectives [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] and $f_*$ is left exact additive, so [lem-pc-derived-acyclic-resolution] identifies the cohomology of $f_*C^\bullet$ with $R^qf_*\mathcal F$ in every degree. This proves the assertion.

split_report.summary: Checked the Cech exactness and acyclicity argument against the blueprint. The local contracting homotopy is elementary; affine intersections and affine-open morphism claims use the existing separated-affine-intersection node, and affine higher-direct-image and affine cohomology vanishing nodes supply the acyclicity. Added one statement-only generic acyclic-resolution lemma for the final derived-functor computation.
split_report.blueprint: Steps realize the three paragraphs of the blueprint proof: local contracting homotopy; affine intersections and vanishing; and computation of the derived direct image from the finite acyclic resolution.

tool_uses.why: The route needs the geometric fact that affine opens of a separated morphism over an affine base have affine intersections; no node in this unit supplies it.
The route needs vanishing of higher direct images for affine morphisms; no node in this unit supplies that theorem.
The route needs quasi-coherent cohomology vanishing on affine schemes; no node in this unit supplies that theorem.
